verdict.rationale: Role- and permission-based access control is a fair question for a robot fleet operations platform, so the axis applies. The pack never documents roles, permissions, or per-robot access scoping for commanding, configuring, or viewing devices. Mentions of a 'governed platform' and bearer-JWT API authentication are adjacent and do not show who may command, configure, or view each robot.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can control with roles and permissions who is allowed to command, configure, or view each robot
